svg.text: ShellA dome with temporary staples
Nina’s block geometry · 211 shell blocks built as closed rings · 530 staples, out at the crown · Isaac Sim renders, untouched
A
Course 4 being laid (60 blocks)
orange = newest blocks, red = staples
B
130 blocks: every open course
is held by its staples
C
Dome closed:
all 530 staples in place
D
Close-up: new block (orange) stapled
to the 3 blocks it rests on (blue)
E
Staples out: the closed dome stands alone
(Isaac Sim: max drift 4.5 mm during the build)
F · How to assemble
Fixed plinth ring first (cast or anchored).
Robot sets a block on the course below, pressed
against the blocks it rests on and its neighbour.
Robot fits a U-clip across each joint to a block below:
2–3 per block, 530 in total. Slots are cast into the
blocks; the clip drops in from outside.
Work round the ring. The last block wedges the ring
closed; then start the next course.
After the top course, pull all clips and re-use them
on the next dome.
Clip rating: 150 N clips broke in PhysX near block 50.
Unbreakable clips: dome stands. Required rating is
being measured; size the clip to that.
Staples hold each new block to the course below until its ring closes · a closed ring wedges itself tight like an arch · once the dome is closed, all staples come out
